scripts.deploy:secondary: aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name sivu-secondary --template-file s3-create-template.yaml --region eu-west-1
scripts.deploy:primary: aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name sivu-primary --template-file s3-create-template.yaml --region eu-north-1
scripts.deploy:cf: aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name sivu-cloudfront --template-file cloudfront.yaml --region us-east-1
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:secondary && npm run deploy:primary && npm run deploy:cf
scripts.upload: export ACCOUNT_ID=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text) && aws s3 sync ../website/ s3://website-eu-north-1-$ACCOUNT_ID/ --region eu-north-1
